verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Clerky handles post-formation paperwork. It offers a legal dashboard for additional paperwork after forming (clerky-docs-8), lets founders issue stock and adopt a stock plan for restricted stock (clerky-docs-9, clerky-docs-16), and completes and submits IRS forms online (clerky-docs-5, clerky-docs-15). A user also mentions a post-incorporation package (clerky-comm-3). However, none of this explicitly names founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment, or 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of founder stock purchase agreements, IP/technology assignment, 83(b) election filing, and independent corroboration that these are correct standard paperwork.
